no_callback_s.note: wall clock, the only wall-clock threshold; read by the editor timer

low_flat_window_s.note: observation window after the user is asked to speak

abs_dbfs.note: absolute level still needs real interface noise floors

rise_db.note: max frame minus P10 of non-zero frames

frame_percentile.note: of the non-zero frame power; the same P10 the rise is measured against

one_sided_delta_db.note: catches crosstalk when the converter is very quiet

steady_hi_percentile.note: picks the louder channel as the reference and tests for a steady signal

steady_max_spread_db.note: hi percentile minus lo percentile below this: no pauses, the signal is continuous

floor_valid_below_active_db.note: a floor reading counts only when it sits this far under the active level

flat_min_peak_dbfs.source: 实录标定（2026-11）：不设下限时误报的干净录音峰值最高 −15.2 dBFS，真正削波的接近 0 dBFS，在 −12 到 −3 之间取值两批结果相同（命中 6、误报 0）；还缺峰值在 −12 到 −3 dBFS 且带平顶的干净录音
flat_min_peak_dbfs.note: a channel whose sample peak is below this is not checked for flat tops; in a real take a quiet steady sweep lined its peaks up inside the noise tolerance

flat_level_floor_frac.note: only excursions above this fraction of the global peak are examined

flat_sigma_k.note: tolerance = max(flat_tol_rel * level, k * sigma of the noise floor)

flat_cap_sigma_k.note: the plateau cap window is max(flat_top_cap_frac * level, k * sigma)

loudness_hop_ms.note: gated loudness hop; the block must be a whole number of hops

loudness_rel_gate_db.note: relative to the mean of the blocks above the absolute gate

clip_evidence_max_marks.note: upper bound on digital clip marks kept as evidence

analysis_rate_max_hz.note: higher rates are decimated by an integer factor first

speech_within_top_db.note: active speech frames lie within this many dB of the top percentile

speech_over_p10_db.note: and at least this far above the frame P10

min_frames.note: fewer frames than this and the percentile is not trusted

f0_accept_hz.source: 实录标定（2026-11）：四条观测的电流声基频偏差都不超过 0.01 Hz；还缺发电机、UPS 等漂移电源的录音

whistle_max_hz.source: 实录标定（2026-11）：安静录音里的假窄峰（转换器、时钟音）在 17.3–23.0 kHz，都高于它；还没有真啸叫的录音，上限只被误报约束
whistle_max_hz.note: narrow peaks above this are not whistle candidates; real takes carry inaudible converter and clock tones up there

whistle_min_dbfs.source: 实录标定（2026-11）：所有假窄峰的单音电平最响 −79.7 dBFS，比它低 9.7 dB；还没有真啸叫的录音（例如 −50 dBFS 的窄音）
whistle_min_dbfs.note: a narrow peak whose own power is below this is not a whistle, however far it stands above its neighbours

slight_below_over_floor_db.source: 实录标定（2026-11）：轻微的电流声谐波峰高出局部底噪 13.2 dB，明显的 19.5、24.0 dB，两侧各留约 3 dB；还缺第二批的电流声正例和真正响的电流声
slight_below_over_floor_db.note: strongest harmonic over its local median below this: still reported, marked slight; the energy share is information only

slight_below_dbfs.source: 实录标定（2026-11）：观测到的四例电流声总电平在 −74.8 到 −88.0 dBFS，都比它低至少 4.8 dB、都判轻微；高于它的一侧还没有录音（缺一条响的电流声）
slight_below_dbfs.note: hum level (all detected harmonics) below this: still reported, marked slight; an absolute stand-in for 'relative to the voice', valid only once the gain step has brought the voice near its target

f0_search_window_frac.note: f0 estimate: window around each nominal harmonic is max(harmonic_window_min_hz, frac * k)

harmonic_energy_halfwidth_hz.note: energy share counts the excess over the local median within this distance of a harmonic

whistle_exclude_halfwidth_hz.note: bins this close to a detected harmonic are not whistle candidates

whistle_group_gap_hz.note: candidate bins further apart than this are separate whistle peaks

level_floor_min_hz.note: lower edge of the band the energy share is measured against

min_segments.note: fewer Welch segments than this and the stability test is not trusted

interior_only.note: leading and trailing zero runs do not count

false_alarm_floor_16bit_dbfs.note: show nothing when the noise floor is below this

evidence_max_marks.note: upper bound on zero-run marks kept as evidence; the counts stay exact

analysis_rate_max_hz.note: higher rates are decimated first; clipping and zero runs are still found at the original rate

rel_db.note: a clap peaks within this many dB of the loudest one

min_gap_s.note: each picked clap masks half of this on either side; the earlier segment ends before the next clap

onset_db.note: a clap peak stands this far above everything in the look-back window before it

onset_gap_ms.note: the look-back window stops this long before the candidate so its own rise is not compared with itself

clip_min_run_samples.note: a clap that reaches the digital clip level for this many samples counts as clipped

min_noise_ms.note: the noise window may be cut by the start of the capture, down to this length

truncate_over_noise_db.note: the decay ends at the first envelope block below the noise plus this margin

filter_order.note: Butterworth prototype order of the band filters

band_pnr_min_db.note: synthetic checks used 30; the final value comes from real recordings

repeat_outlier_frac.source: 规格起始值，待实录标定
repeat_outlier_frac.note: per band, claps further than this from the median are dropped

repeat_min_kept.source: 规格起始值，待实录标定

gate_margin_db.source: 规格起始值，待实录标定
gate_margin_db.note: a drop only counts as a gate while the band is still this far above its noise

gate_tail_drop_db.note: beyond the decay the fitted slope predicts

gate_search_from_ms.note: the window before a drop starts this long after the band peak, past the direct sound

tail_snr_min_db.note: below this the tail is not measurable and only a lower bound is reported

recording_band_hz.note: band to compare on real recordings

low_f0_sensitivity_below_hz.source: 待定：只有两个嗓音（约 120、240 Hz）且与话筒一一绑定；缺同一人用两支话筒，或第三个嗓音（150–180 Hz）

floor_percentile.note: of the take's own envelope frames; the word list leaves pauses between words

onset_baseline_ms.note: the rise is measured against the quietest frame this far before the frame

syllable_merge_ms.note: a burst followed by the vowel onset within this gap is one syllable

reference_max_db.source: 经验值，依据实录标定：3 间房、2 位说话人、2 支话筒（2026-11）：两位说话人 5 cm 时每遍字表的最大值都超过它，60 cm 时都低于它；一位在 15 cm 处有一遍超过
reference_max_db.note: reference shown next to the worst syllable of each pass; above it the card gives a light hint, no grade

min_effective_bandwidth_hz.note: below this the high band is switched off

noise_frame_percentile.note: frames at or below this percentile of the wideband level make the noise spectrum

flatness_min.note: geometric over arithmetic mean of the 3-12 kHz bins

noise_subtract_floor_db.note: after subtracting the noise spectrum each bin keeps at least this much of the noise

bandwidth_over_noise_db.note: effective bandwidth: highest point whose band the speech stays this far over the band noise floor; the search stops after bandwidth_stop_points failing points in a row

bandwidth_band_hz.source: 规格：实录里说话几乎不停的一段被按最安静帧的底噪误判成 2.1 kHz（实际高于 16 kHz），改用频带底噪、按 500 Hz 频点走、连续 2 点不满足才停
bandwidth_band_hz.note: each point looks at a band this wide around it

bandwidth_step_hz.source: 规格：实录里说话几乎不停的一段被按最安静帧的底噪误判成 2.1 kHz（实际高于 16 kHz），改用频带底噪、按 500 Hz 频点走、连续 2 点不满足才停

bandwidth_stop_points.source: 规格：实录里说话几乎不停的一段被按最安静帧的底噪误判成 2.1 kHz（实际高于 16 kHz），改用频带底噪、按 500 Hz 频点走、连续 2 点不满足才停
bandwidth_stop_points.note: stop after this many failing points in a row

bandwidth_noise_percentile.source: 规格：实录里说话几乎不停的一段被按最安静帧的底噪误判成 2.1 kHz（实际高于 16 kHz），改用频带底噪、按 500 Hz 频点走、连续 2 点不满足才停
bandwidth_noise_percentile.note: the noise floor of a band is this percentile of its per-frame power over all frames

vowel_gap_ms.source: 规格起始值：与实录分析同一种取法
vowel_gap_ms.note: the vowel reference starts this long after the fricative ends

vowel_window_ms.source: 规格起始值：与实录分析同一种取法
vowel_window_ms.note: and ends this long after the fricative ends

vowel_centroid_max_hz.source: 规格起始值：与实录分析同一种取法
vowel_centroid_max_hz.note: vowel frames have their centroid below this

vowel_within_db.source: 规格起始值：与实录分析同一种取法
vowel_within_db.note: and are within this of the loudest frame in the window

vowel_min_frames.source: 规格起始值：与实录分析同一种取法
vowel_min_frames.note: fewer kept frames: this fricative has no vowel reference

vowel_loudest_frac.source: 规格起始值：与实录分析同一种取法
vowel_loudest_frac.note: the vowel level is the mean of this share of the loudest kept frames

reference_max_db.source: 经验值（常见做法的默认），依据实录标定：3 间房、2 位说话人、2 支话筒（2026-11）：两位说话人在唱歌位置（约 15 cm）6–12 kHz 对元音的中位比值分别为 −5.4、−7.1 dB，都低于它；一位挪到 60 cm 后升到 −2.8 dB，比值随距离的方向不稳，只作参考
reference_max_db.note: reference for the 6-12 kHz over vowel ratio; not shown when the high band is off

analysis_window_s.note: length of natural speech the session captures for this analysis; the analysis itself takes whatever it is given

residual_median_multiple.source: 规格起始值，待实录标定
residual_median_multiple.note: LPC residual over its local scale; starting range 15-20 adjusted on real recordings, uncalibrated

moderate_per_min.source: 待定：口水音只作提示、不分档；缺第二位说话人的试听标签和安静段每分钟的误报率

heavy_per_min.source: 待定：口水音只作提示、不分档；缺第二位说话人的试听标签和安静段每分钟的误报率

candidate_multiple.note: residual samples over this multiple are grouped into candidates; the candidate's own peak must reach residual_median_multiple

lpc_block_ms.source: 合成验证：起点在一个周期内逐样本平移，读数的变化在容差内
lpc_block_ms.note: a predictor is estimated at the centre of every block; each sample interpolates the coefficients of the two nearest centres

lpc_white_noise_frac.note: added to the zero-lag autocorrelation so the predictor stays stable

scale_hop_ms.source: 合成验证：起点在一个周期内逐样本平移，读数的变化在容差内
scale_hop_ms.note: one block median this often; each sample interpolates the scale of the two nearest block centres

scale_trim_frac.source: 合成验证：起点在一个周期内逐样本平移，读数的变化在容差内；合成元音起止处的基音脉冲仍在计数门限以下
scale_trim_frac.note: the local scale is the mean of the block medians within the half width after dropping this share at each end; a plain median jumps between the speech and the pause blocks, a wider kept band lowers the scale near speech edges and lets pitch pulses through

scale_halfwidth_ms.note: running median of the block medians of the residual magnitude

fricative_median_db.note: high-passed envelope after the spike, relative to the spike's envelope peak

speech_hop_ms.source: 合成验证：起点在一个周期内逐样本平移，读数的变化在容差内
speech_hop_ms.note: speech level frames overlap; one frame this often, each frame a whole number of these

speech_over_floor_db.note: the loud frames must stand this far above the quiet ones, otherwise there is no speech to measure against

context_max_rel_db.source: 规格起始值，待实录标定
context_max_rel_db.note: high-frequency background around the spike, relative to the speech; louder backgrounds are sibilant onsets or aspiration; adjusted on real recordings, uncalibrated

reference_max_per_min.source: 经验值，依据实录标定：3 间房、2 位说话人、2 支话筒（2026-11）：两位说话人在约 15 cm 处每分钟的读数都低于它，刻意咂嘴时高于它；检出里仍有送气音的误报，只作参考
reference_max_per_min.note: reference for clicks per minute; above it the card gives a light hint, no grade

active_within_top_db.note: active frames lie within this many dB of the top percentile

dr_resolution_db.source: 工程起始值，依据实录：同一位置各下拍手的 D/R 差 0.3–2 dB，15 cm 挪到 60 cm 时降 4.3–5.2 dB（两间房）
dr_resolution_db.note: a retest counts as a sign only when the D/R moved by more than this; a lower bound only rules out one direction

plosive_resolution_db.source: 工程起始值，依据实录：60 cm 处字表最大值两人分别 6.7、7.5 dB，15 cm 处出现过单个 17.3 dB 的音节；缺同一位置重复字表的散布
plosive_resolution_db.note: a retest counts as a sign only when the worst syllable moved by more than this

sibilance_resolution_db.source: 工程起始值，依据实录：同一增益下两次测试的擦音中位电平，95% 置信能分辨的差两人分别约 5.2、1.6 dB，取较大的
sibilance_resolution_db.note: 6-12 kHz level after noise subtraction, same gain only; a retest counts as a sign only when it moved by more than this

critical_distance_coef.source: 规格起始值：临界距离公式（扩散声场近似）
critical_distance_coef.note: critical distance in metres = coef x sqrt(directivity x volume / T20)

room_volume_m3.source: 工程起始值：典型卧室，约 3 × 4 × 2.5 m
room_volume_m3.note: typical room volume for the empirical distance limit; the plugin cannot measure the volume

source_directivity.source: 工程起始值：人声正前方的指向性因子；话筒自身的指向性不计入，上限因此偏近

limit_critical_frac.source: 工程起始值：临界距离的一半，扩散声场下那里的直达声比房间声高约 6 dB
limit_critical_frac.note: the empirical distance limit is this fraction of the critical distance

condenser_around_cm.source: 产品约定：常见做法，维护者确认（2026-11）
condenser_around_cm.note: condenser, USB and not sure: about this far

condenser_range_cm.source: 产品约定：常见做法，维护者确认（2026-11）
condenser_range_cm.note: condenser, USB and not sure: stay within

dynamic_range_cm.source: 产品约定：常见做法，维护者确认（2026-11）
dynamic_range_cm.note: dynamic: about this far; headset: none

direction_impact.note: impact of fixing: turning the microphone the right way round costs almost nothing and fixes the most; score = impact x confidence / cost

direction_cost.note: relative effort of the fix: turning the microphone the right way round costs almost nothing and fixes the most

room_impact.note: impact of fixing: room advice (move closer, treat or change the room); score = impact x confidence / cost

room_cost.note: relative effort of the fix: room advice (move closer, treat or change the room)

hum_impact.note: impact of fixing: electrical hum, buzz or whistle (slight hum is never a candidate); score = impact x confidence / cost

hum_cost.note: relative effort of the fix: electrical hum, buzz or whistle (slight hum is never a candidate)

gain_impact.note: impact of fixing: input gain outside the good band (digital clipping is fixed first and not scored here); score = impact x confidence / cost

gain_cost.note: relative effort of the fix: input gain outside the good band (digital clipping is fixed first and not scored here)

noise_impact.note: impact of fixing: broadband noise with a bad A-weighted SNR; score = impact x confidence / cost

noise_cost.note: relative effort of the fix: broadband noise with a bad A-weighted SNR

live_clap_every_s.note: how often the room step re-reads the claps so far to give per-clap feedback

notice_s.note: countdown shown before a phase or step restarts by itself; counted in samples

restarts_max.note: how many times one step may restart a phase by itself (clipped soft claps, gated claps); after that it carries on and the analysis reports the retest

realtime_ratio_max.note: audio arriving faster than this multiple of real time means an offline render the host did not announce; the step is voided

realtime_check_min_s.note: wall-clock time before the mid-step speed check starts; the check at the end of a step always runs

capture_buffer_s.note: audio the capture ring holds while the worker is busy; a full ring voids the step as an overflow

evidence_hop_min_s.note: narrowest cell of a step's evidence envelope, rounded up to whole samples

evidence_cells_max.note: most cells in one step's evidence envelope; longer steps merge whole narrow cells into wider ones

evidence_events_max.note: most plosive, sibilance and mouth-noise events in one step's evidence; the earliest are kept
